errors: Production, setup and startup variables are not indexed by machine. Setup and startup costs are therefore charged once per product-period, even when both machines produce the same product (e.g. production[0,0]=77.66 uses both machines but pays one setup and one startup).

The machine capacity constraint multiplies production by 0, so it only limits startup time. Production quantities and startup time never compete for a machine's capacity. Startup time is not subtracted from the capacity available for production.

The assign variables are not tied to setup or startup. A machine can be 'assigned' to a product with no setup (assign[0,0,2]=1 while setup[0,2]=0), and startups are not defined per machine, so the rule that a machine can be started up only if it was not producing that product in the previous period is not modeled correctly.

The production-capacity link allows total production for a product to reach the sum of both machines' capacities with only one setup/startup charge, which understates cost. The reported objective of 703.46 is likely too low.
assumptions: A big-M of 1000 is used for linking production to setup and assignment.
